contract: Use the released finite-element Virtual Temperature Method, not a graph proxy.
Use Equation 6's p=20 temperature norm and the released paper-cutting entrypoint's 192x192 Q1 mesh, 2x2 supercell, sink Gamma, q0, conductivity range, and SIMP penalty.
Both positive and disconnected-control densities must be exactly periodic and p6mm invariant.
An independent flood fill must find zero unreachable material in the connected design and nonzero unreachable material in the island design.
The island VTM score must exceed twice the connected score.
Independent score recomputation and the free-DOF linear-system residual must pass.
A fixed released-adjoint descent step must reduce the VTM score.
A verifier must reject deliberate periodicity and p6mm violations.
